messages.content:
You mark claims in a draft expert report so that code can check them against the record.

The user message is one JSON object. "paragraphs" lists numbered paragraphs of the draft's text, each with "para" (a number, or "fnN" for footnote N), "text", "tagged" (character ranges the drafter has already tagged), "refs" (footnote references as [offset, footnote number]) and "propose" (true when you should mark claims in it). "context" lists footnotes those paragraphs reference, for reading only. "rejected", when present, lists the elements of your previous reply that failed a check, with the plain-English reasons; fix them and resend the full array of proposals for the message, including the elements that already passed.

Reply with a JSON array and nothing else. Each element is an object with exactly these keys:
  "para"  the paragraph's "para" value
  "span"  the claim's words, copied exactly from that paragraph's text
  "cite"  the cite for the claim, copied exactly from the same sentence or from a footnote that sentence references, or "" when there is none
  "kind"  "figure", "date", "quote", "words" or "flag"
An element of kind "words" adds the key "value". An element of kind "flag" adds the key "reason".

Mark every figure, date and quotation in a paragraph whose "propose" is true. Leave out the tagged ranges, bare years, and the draft's own references to its sections, paragraphs, pages, tables, figures and footnotes. One element holds one value.

Kind "quote" marks a quotation of four or more words. Its span includes its opening and closing quote marks, copied exactly from the paragraph's text, or the quoted words in a block quote that has no quote marks.

Kind "words" marks a number or date written in words, such as "four thousand eight hundred and twelve", "two and a half percent", "the fourteenth of March 2019" or "the first quarter of 2019". Its span is the number words alone, without a unit such as "units". Its "value" is the number in digits ("4812", "2.5%") or the date as YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-Qn for a quarter.

Kind "flag" marks a figure, date or quotation written in digits or quote marks that is not a claim about the record. Its span is that figure, date or quotation exactly as written. Its "reason" is one of cross_reference, page_or_section_number, count_in_prose, date_of_report, scare_quote, label.

When the user message has "job": "candidates" instead of "paragraphs", each item is a claim with no page-level cite, with up to five candidate locations in the record and a snippet of each. Reply with a JSON array of objects with exactly the keys "item" (the item's "item" value) and "choice" (the "rank" of the candidate whose snippet supports the claim). Leave out an item when no snippet supports it.

Never add a key, never judge whether a claim is right, and never invent words or cites.

{
 "context": [],
 "kinds": [
  "date",
  "figure",
  "flag",
  "quote",
  "words"
 ],
 "paragraphs": [
  {
   "block_quote": false,
   "heading": false,
   "para": 27,
   "propose": true,
   "refs": [],
   "tagged": [],
   "text": "Shipments first fell below the minimum in July, at 4,780 units (Prewett Dep. 12:16-17). Ms. Prewett raised the shortfall with Mr. Esterby on August 4, 2023 (Id. at 12:20), and he called it a \"timing issue\" at one terminal. The low point came in August at 4,610 units (shipments.csv!B18). September shipments were 4,812 units (shipments.csv!B19), billed at $585,861 (shipments.csv!C19) on an invoice dated September 29, 2023 (PX-4 at 1). Over the three months before the notice, shipments averaged 4,734 units a month."
  },
  {
   "block_quote": false,
   "heading": false,
   "para": 28,
   "propose": true,
   "refs": [],
   "tagged": [],
   "text": "The August invoice, dated 8/31/2023, covered 4,610 units for $561,267.50 (PX-4 at 1). The last regular invoice is dated 10/31/2023 (Id. at 2). October fell short of the minimum by seventy-five units, and the shortfall invoice for $9,131.25 (Id.) remains disputed."
  },
  {
   "block_quote": false,
   "heading": false,
   "para": 30,
   "propose": true,
   "refs": [],
   "tagged": [],
   "text": "The notice blamed delays in delivery, and the record does not support that reason. Ostmarren's own scorecard for Q2 2023 rated Brindlecote a preferred supplier with a defect rate of 0.31% (OSTL0004020). For the third quarter it rated on-time delivery at 96.8% and the defect rate at 0.27% (OSTL0004021). Mr. Esterby testified that delivery performance was \"mentioned in the deck\" (Esterby Dep. 32:1), and that price was the reason for the change."
  },
  {
   "block_quote": false,
   "heading": false,
   "para": 31,
   "propose": true,
   "refs": [],
   "tagged": [],
   "text": "The committee approved the exit on July 11, 2023 (DX-104 at 8) and asked Ostmarren's chief operating officer to sign the notice once Garrowfield's parts were qualified. The next day, on 2023-07-12, Mr. Esterby wrote that \"[t]he committee's decision is made and we move to Garrowfield\" (OSTL0004022). He did not tell Brindlecote. Ostmarren's forecasts, by its own account, had been within 4.2% (DX-102 at 4) of actual purchases, so the cut it planned for the fourth quarter was a decision rather than a guess."
  },
  {
   "block_quote": false,
   "heading": false,
   "para": 32,
   "propose": true,
   "refs": [],
   "tagged": [],
   "text": "The agreement allows termination for cause only if a breach is not cured \"within sixty days after receiving notice describing the breach in reasonable detail\" (PX-1 at 5). Ms. Prewett testified that Brindlecote \"never received a notice of breach or a request to cure\" (Prewett Dep. 14:18-19). I therefore measure damages over the rest of the term, as counsel instructed."
  },
  {
   "block_quote": false,
   "heading": false,
   "para": 35,
   "propose": true,
   "refs": [],
   "tagged": [],
   "text": "The damages period runs from the first month after the effective date through the last full month of the term, 16 months (model.csv!B2) in all. At the minimum commitment, Brindlecote lost sales of 76,800 units (model.csv!B4) over that period. At the amended price, lost revenue is $9.35 million (model.csv!B6)."
  }
 ]
}
